title: Member 3 Payment Orchestration & PayPal Handoff Contract
description: Cryptographic authorization package issued by Member 2 to Member 3 for verification before invoking PayPal capture.

public_key.description: 32-byte Ed25519 public key in hexadecimal format.

intent_hash.description: SHA-512 cryptographic commitment of the RFC 8785 canonical intent payload.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp after which the token is invalid (60-second window).
